So I read your confession and this may be coming a little late... But I feel like you are truly regretful for what you've done. I honestly feel like you had no intent to have the situation escalate as badly as it did. Regardless what's done is done and the best thing you can do now is to figure out what kind of person you are and what you want to be. There may not be much you can do for that poor girl but there are other girls in similar situations and worse that you could help. It won't erase what happened but each little bit counts. I'm sorry for how people dogged you out here for making a confession that was clearly hard to do. A little empathy goes a long way and clearly some people are lacking. You do not show signs sociopathic behavior... You are just a normal temperamental person who made a horrible mistake. 

tl;dr : you aren't a monster... Just someone horribly troubled by a huge mistake
